title: helianthemum vineale subsp. marifolium
intro: Helianthemum vineale subsp. marifolium, commonly known as the rockrose or sun rose, is a plant species within the Helianthemum genus. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum vineale subsp. marifolium include anti-hemorrhagic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in treating various health conditions such as gastrointestinal issues and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
